How Baltimore connects

  • Work: Serial Season 1 — Season 1 investigates a 1999 murder and trial in Baltimore.
  • Location: Leakin Park — Leakin Park is in west Baltimore.
  • Character: Adnan Syed — Adnan Syed's case was tried in Baltimore.
  • Location: Woodlawn High School — Woodlawn High School is in the Baltimore area.

What is Baltimore?

Baltimore is the setting of Serial Season 1: a 1999 disappearance, a trial in city court, a park where Hae Min Lee was found, and a community Koenig keeps driving back to.

Key threads lead to Serial Season 1, Leakin Park, Adnan Syed and Woodlawn High School.
